// Check that uvm_re_match searches the regular expression in the string,
// that globs still match whole names, and the related lookups in
// uvm_resource_db and uvm_config_db::wait_modified.
//----------------------------------------------------------------------

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

using namespace uvm;

static void check(const std::string& what, bool ok)
{
  std::cout << (ok ? "PASS: " : "FAIL: ") << what << std::endl;
}

class leaf : public uvm_component
{
public:
  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(leaf);
  leaf(uvm_component_name name) : uvm_component(name) {}
};

class env : public uvm_component
{
public:
  leaf* a;
  leaf* b;
  int a_woken, b_woken, root_woken;

  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(env);

  env(uvm_component_name name)
  : uvm_component(name), a(nullptr), b(nullptr),
    a_woken(0), b_woken(0), root_woken(0) {}

  void build_phase(uvm_phase& phase)
  {
    a = leaf::type_id::create("a", this);
    b = leaf::type_id::create("b", this);
  }

  void wait_a()
  {
    while (true)
    {
      uvm_config_db<int>::wait_modified(a, "", "speed");
      a_woken++;
    }
  }

  void wait_b()
  {
    while (true)
    {
      uvm_config_db<int>::wait_modified(b, "", "speed");
      b_woken++;
    }
  }

  void wait_root()
  {
    while (true)
    {
      uvm_config_db<int>::wait_modified(nullptr, "", "level");
      root_woken++;
    }
  }

  void run_phase(uvm_phase& phase)
  {
    phase.raise_objection(this);

    sc_core::sc_spawn(sc_bind(&env::wait_a, this));
    sc_core::sc_spawn(sc_bind(&env::wait_b, this));
    sc_core::sc_spawn(sc_bind(&env::wait_root, this));
    sc_core::wait(1, sc_core::SC_NS);

    // relative to a context: only the waiter for 'a' is woken
    uvm_config_db<int>::set(this, "a", "speed", 1);
    sc_core::wait(1, sc_core::SC_NS);
    check("wait_modified woken by set(this, \"a\", ...)", a_woken == 1);
    check("wait_modified not woken by setting for other instance", b_woken == 0);

    // absolute path
    uvm_config_db<int>::set(nullptr, b->get_full_name(), "speed", 2);
    sc_core::wait(1, sc_core::SC_NS);
    check("wait_modified woken by set(nullptr, <full name>, ...)", b_woken == 1);
    check("wait_modified not woken by setting for other instance", a_woken == 1);

    // global
    uvm_config_db<int>::set(nullptr, "", "level", 1);
    sc_core::wait(1, sc_core::SC_NS);
    check("wait_modified(nullptr, \"\", ...) woken by set(nullptr, \"\", ...)",
          root_woken == 1);

    phase.drop_objection(this);
  }
};

class test : public uvm_test
{
public:
  env* e;

  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(test);

  test(uvm_component_name name) : uvm_test(name), e(nullptr) {}

  void build_phase(uvm_phase& phase)
  {
    uvm_test::build_phase(phase);
    e = env::type_id::create("env", this);
  }
};

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  // uvm_re_match returns false on a match
  check("regex is searched in string", !uvm_re_match("/env/", "test.env.agent"));
  check("regex without match", uvm_re_match("/foo/", "test.env.agent"));
  check("anchored regex", uvm_re_match("/^env/", "test.env.agent"));
  check("glob matches whole name", !uvm_re_match(uvm_glob_to_re("test.env*"), "test.env.agent"));
  check("glob does not match part of name", uvm_re_match(uvm_glob_to_re("env"), "test.env.agent"));
  check("glob does not match prefix", uvm_re_match(uvm_glob_to_re("test"), "test.env.agent"));
  check("uvm_is_match glob", uvm_is_match("*.env.*", "test.env.agent"));
  check("uvm_is_match glob no match", !uvm_is_match("env", "test.env.agent"));
  check("empty expression matches empty string", !uvm_re_match("", ""));
  check("empty expression does not match non-empty string", uvm_re_match("", "test"));

  // resource lookups
  uvm_resource_db<int>::set("/env/", "rx", 3);
  int v = 0;
  check("resource with regex scope found",
        uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("test.env.agent", "rx", v) && v == 3);
  check("resource with regex scope not found elsewhere",
        !uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("test.agent", "rx", v));

  uvm_resource_db<int>::set("test.env", "glob", 4);
  check("resource with glob scope found",
        uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("test.env", "glob", v) && v == 4);
  check("resource with glob scope not found in sub scope",
        !uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("test.env.agent", "glob", v));

  uvm_resource_db<int>::set("", "empty", 5);
  check("resource with empty scope found for empty name",
        uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("", "empty", v) && v == 5);
  check("resource with empty scope not found in other scope",
        !uvm_resource_db<int>::read_by_name("test.env", "empty", v));

  run_test("test");

  return 0;
}
